title: Fourier mass under random restrictions
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ and $0\leq\delta\leq1$. For each $S\subseteq[n]$, let $\widehat f(S)$ be the uniform Fourier coefficient of $f$ at the character $x\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}x_i$. Then $\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}\delta^{|S|}|\widehat f(S)|$ is at most the expected value of $2^D$ under a random restriction that leaves each coordinate free independently with probability $\delta$ and fixes every other coordinate to an independent uniform sign, where $D$ is the decision-tree depth of the restricted function.
